head: codex/5824-v092-prompt-card-enum-typing
title: [v0.92][WP-07] Complete prompt-card enum typing audit
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5824

## Summary
- Derive the complete restricted-type denominator from current C-SDLC v2 source, including scalar strings in structs and enum variants.
- Retain digest-bound dispositions for all 132 candidates; the audit found zero justified finite enum gaps, so no production type churn was introduced.
- Add focused proof for enum and tagged-enum behavior, all six card round trips, active template parity, typed invalid-value diagnostics, mutation safety, and legacy rejection.

## Validation
- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/5824/validate-enum-inventory.rb` (PASS: 132 candidates, 0 finite gaps)
- `cargo nextest run --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --no-tests=fail --test prompt_card_enum_typing` (PASS: 6/6)
- `csdlc-validate --root . issue --issue 5824` (PASS)
- `git diff --check` (PASS)
- Independent bounded review: PASS, no actionable findings
